scope: Additional T2 encoder fine-tuning on the same AI-translated silver pilot; not independent native-Vietnamese validation
loss: cross entropy, inverse-frequency weights from training only
selection: best dev macro-F1 per run, earlier epoch on tie; choose learning rate by mean of 3 development scores, lower learning rate on tie; retain all three selected-seed models
test_policy: model/selection hashes frozen before test predictions; report all 3 selected seed results, no best-test seed selection
